description: handle_email_changes in crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs (lines 545-553) builds the JSON response without the updatedProperties field. RFC 8620 §5.2 requires updatedProperties in every /changes response. Every other /changes handler in the workspace has it; Email/changes was missed in the round-2 fix sweep. A client receiving this response will either reject it or fail to update its cache correctly.
title: Email/changes missing updatedProperties field
